notice: SYNTHETIC and RECORDED evaluation cases for Sprint 9N. Runtime cases run against the synthetic agent world (fictional SYN- entities) in two arms: observe (the Sprint 9M control flow) and enforce (Sprint 9N default). Recorded cases read live artefacts stored by earlier sprints, as run. Live-target cases have no stored trace and are not run. None of this is new Qloo or model evidence.
holdout: None. Every runtime case was written during Sprint 9N, after the live traces were read; Sprint 9O live runs are the first independent test.
